Questa capacità di business funge da unica fonte di verità per le posizioni dei clienti, la reportistica delle prestazioni e le intuizioni analitiche dell’ecosistema digitale di Julius Baer, sostenendo sia gli stakeholder interni che i clienti esterni.

In questo ruolo chiave, guiderai la roadmap del prodotto e della consegna da una prospettiva aziendale con una comprensione approfondita dei processi aziendali sottostanti per derivare, sequenza ed eseguire pietre miliari e obiettivi secondo le priorità chiave stabilite. La vostra centricità cliente metterà i guardrails per il team, guidandoli a crescere con le esigenze digitali e mobili dei nostri clienti e assicurando che il loro lavoro si traduce in esperienze digitali intuitive e di impatto. Potrai lavorare in stretta collaborazione con business unit, leadership IT, Enterprise Architecture e stakeholder internazionali per garantire la consegna sistematica contro la roadmap impostata. Potrai condurre un team di proprietari di prodotti, analisti aziendali e esperti di materia come un Business Stream Lead all'interno del Portfolio e Gestione della posizione Agile Release Train (ART).

Segnalando la posizione e Portfolio Management leader all'interno di Digital Delivery, guiderai un team multifunzionale e globale responsabile della guida dell'innovazione, della scalabilità e dell'eccellenza operativa in tutta la piattaforma.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Atto come il principale business delivery lead per la gestione della posizione centrale all'interno dell'ART, garantendo l'allineamento tra prodotti, tecnologia, design, dati, rischi e funzioni aziendali

• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, influenza senza autorità diretta, e dimostrare una forte mentalità analitica con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

• Esperienza nella guida della fornitura di punti di vista degli asset digitali e soluzioni di reporting dei clienti all'interno di un ambiente bancario privato

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated leader to drive the evolution of our Core Position Management and Portfolio Analysis (Temenos Triple A) and client reporting capability. This business capability serves as the single source of truth for client positions, performance reporting, and analytical insights across Julius Baer’s digital ecosystem — supporting both internal stakeholders and external clients.

In this key role, you will drive the product and delivery roadmap from a business perspective with a thorough understanding of underlying business processes to derive, sequence and execute milestones and objectives according to key priorities set. Your client centricity will set the guardrails for the team, guiding them to grow with the digital and mobile demands of our clients and ensuring their work translates into intuitive, impactful digital experiences. You will work in close collaboration with business units, IT leadership, Enterprise Architecture, and international stakeholders to ensure systematic delivery against the set roadmap. You will lead a team of Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts as a Business Stream Lead within the Portfolio and Position Management Agile Release Train (ART).

Reporting into the Position and Portfolio Management lead within Digital Delivery, you will lead a cross-functional, global team responsible for driving innovation, scalability, and operational excellence across the platform.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as the senior business delivery lead for core position management within the ART, ensuring alignment between product, technology, design, data, risk, and business functions

• Define and align the stream’s strategic objectives within the digital delivery target landscape, ensuring the core banking strategy aligns with the future-state architecture picture

• Own and steer the stream’s roadmap end-to-end, balancing business priorities, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and time-to-value while aligning priorities with senior stakeholders

• Ensure a superior client experience by understanding client needs and maintaining an accurate, reliable, performant and stable capability framework

• Drive predictable, high-quality end-to-end delivery by providing clear decision-making, risk management, and escalation paths across governance boards

• Ensure transparent financial and progress reporting to the ART Lead, managing the stream's delivery budget and resource allocation effectively to maximise business value

• Represent the stream's delivery roadmap at senior governance levels, proactively managing dependencies, risks, and cross-functional coordination

• Lead and coach a team of Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

• Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in agile roles within wealth management, asset management, or investment operations, with at least 3 years as a delivery lead (Business Stream Lead, or equivalent) with personnel responsibility

• Profound understanding of portfolio analysis concepts it’s use in everyday interaction by Relationship Managers and Clients, including position & portfolio valuation, performance measurement, and transaction information to provide clients a comprehensive portfolio and position insights and details about their assets

• In-depth understanding of SAFe principles, DevOps practices, and managing end-to-end delivery for large-scale transformation programmes

• Experience managing distributed teams in a global, multicultural environment, including nearshore and offshore delivery models

• Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to coach teams, remove impediments at scale, and communicate effectively with business/project stakeholders across seniority levels as well as within the own delivery team

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, influence without direct authority, and demonstrate a strong analytical mindset with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Experience in driving the delivery of digital asset views and client reporting solutions within a private banking environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities - with Crossplane and Kubernetes-native control planes at the core of that strategy.

Join our team as a Platform Engineer and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of Kubernetes-native control planes using Crossplane, building providers and functions in Golang following the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Design and extend self-service infrastructure offerings that let product teams provision and manage their own resources reliably and at scale

• Build and maintain workflow automation on our orchestration platform, including writing and reviewing the underlying business logic in JavaScript and other scripting languages (we're also evaluating and migrating toward a new automation tooling stack, so adaptability here matters)

• Contribute to technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 3 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework, to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Experience building or extending workflow automation tooling including writing business logic in JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar - deep expertise in any specific vendor tool is not required, as we understand tools change over time

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of software development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling

• Experience with Golang and at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python

• Experience with Git and agile development methodologies

• Understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure (Windows, Linux, networking, virtualisation, cloud) is a big plus

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)
